topic: Adding time granulation filters to analytics
summary_markdown: A client requested new filtering capabilities within the analytics platform. Specifically, the need was identified for time granularity filters to be available across all environments. Additional required filters include options to filter by weekday (Monday–Friday) and by weekend (Saturday–Sunday). The conversation focused on assigning ownership of this task among team members.
decisions: The development of time granulation filters must be implemented in all environments.
action_items: Determine the correct owner for creating the task related to adding new analytics filters.
